functional_requirements: Provide a rigid 90-degree L-shaped mounting bracket with a horizontal base plate and vertical upright leg.
Allow a 6 mm bolt or equivalent fastener to pass through the vertical face via a 6 mm through-hole.
Hole must be centered horizontally on the vertical face and located 15 mm below the top edge.
Bracket must be manufacturable by FDM 3D printing with a minimum wall thickness of 5 mm.
Part must be a single connected solid suitable for export as a watertight mesh.
special_features: The part MUST be an L-bracket with a horizontal base plate and a vertical upright leg meeting at 90 degrees, both having THICKNESS = 5 mm.
The vertical upright MUST be located at the back edge of the base: outer face at Y = VERTICAL_FACE_OUTER_Y = -15 mm and inner face at Y = VERTICAL_FACE_INNER_Y = -10 mm, not centered on the base.
The vertical face (outer face of the upright) MUST lie in the XZ plane at Y = VERTICAL_FACE_OUTER_Y = -15 mm.

The through-hole MUST be centered on the vertical face at X = HOLE_CENTER_X = 0 mm and Z = HOLE_CENTER_Z = 15 mm, which is HOLE_CENTER_FROM_TOP_Z = 15 mm below the top edge at Z = OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z = 30 mm.
The through-hole MUST penetrate along the Y axis through the 5 mm upright thickness, not along the X or Z axis.
The part MUST be symmetric about the YZ plane (X = 0); left and right halves MUST mirror about X = 0.
The through-hole diameter MUST be HOLE_DIAMETER = 6 mm.
The overall bounding box MUST be 40 mm (X) x 30 mm (Y) x 30 mm (Z) within the specified tolerances.
MUST NOT include fillets, chamfers, or additional holes not specified in the request.
